output.attribution_rationale: The single-arm programme combined AI-read X-rays, community mobilisation, sputum collection and molecular testing, with no comparison isolating AI's contribution.

achieved_dates.note: The news report gives July 2025–March 2026; April 2026 is the evaluation date, and continued delivery is not established.

conflict.note: The entry discloses programme-affiliated researchers, but the source establishes no vendor employment, funding, equity, patent or licence conflict.

tests.note: No control, prior-period comparison or credible benchmark measures the programme's benefit; the cited prevalence survey provides background only.

output.summary: The complete news article reports 877 confirmed TB cases among 168,568 people screened during July 2025–March 2026. It establishes programme yield but provides no comparison showing additional cases attributable to the intervention.
